segments.name: Open Commerce Platform
segments.description: Operates an AI-driven Open Commerce platform enabling brands, distributors and retailers in high-growth consumer markets to trade fast-moving consumer goods.
segments.evidence: We have developed and operate the RedCloud Platform, that facilitates the trading of everyday consumer supplies of fast-moving consumer goods ("FMCG") products across business supply chains.

revenueModel.text: The company charges brands and distributors based on a consumption model, only for transactions made on the Platform.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Platform is delivered through a consumption-based business model and we only charging brands and distributors for transactions made on the Platform.

changes.text: In 2024, RedCloud Holdings plc was incorporated and became the ultimate holding company of the RedCloud Group through the Formation Transaction.
changes.evidence: On October 11, 2024, we undertook a formation transaction pursuant to which all existing security holders of RedCloud Technologies Limited, a private limited company incorporated in England and Wales, exchanged the securities they held in RedCloud Technologies Limited for an equivalent class and number of securities in RedCloud Holdings plc.
